reviews.title: The WORST!
reviews.text:
I purchased the pro subscription to play with my granddaughters (for trying new hairstyles, mostly). I regret that I paid for it for a whole year. I now understand why some apps, like this one, charge less for a subscription if you don’t try it out first in a free trial! They don’t want you to know how bad it is before giving them your money. Buyers Beware!
The features are so redundant. Nothing new to see here. And when you attempt to edit a photo - even just a slight color change - the app takes FOREVER to generate the image! It is so slow, that I’d end up just giving up waiting for it, and swiping out of the app before ever getting to see it. 
Worst of all, they use these stupid “credit” things, meaning that even with their versions of a “pro subscription”, you don’t have unlimited use. You just get a few images, then you have to wait until the next month to get a few more. That’s not a subscription, in my opinion. 
Anyway, just wanted to make sure others understand what they’re getting (or “not getting” is a more appropriate term) with this app before you give them your money. I won’t ever purchase from this developer again, that’s for sure.

reviews.title: BUYERS BEWARE
reviews.text: In app purchases for this game are charged double the advertised amount. When this app was just a straightforward annual purchase everything worked perfectly, and I mean it was hands down the best line of editing apps available for a while there, but then AI was incorporated into the product that offers an interminably endless range of prospects; like if you can imagine it, this app can create it. HOWEVER, when they started adding optional features made up mostly of AI products that you have to pay extra for the credits needed to utilize them, it has since become a TRAP! No matter which selection of credits you purchase, be prepared to be charged double. The 20-40% off “sales” are merely decorative as far as I can tell since they will charge you the full price and then some with every purchase you make. So now, what I once saw as my go-to for editing applications is now better described as yet another “ol’ bait and switch” scam. I’ll still use it until my prepaid subscription expires, but after that, if the issue with overcharges isn’t resolved, I’ll be deleting the apps, never to look back again. From five stars to fully fraudulent apps, it’s become highway robbery.

reviews.title: Cancel subscription
reviews.text:
I am extremely frustrated with my recent experience trying to cancel a subscription and request a refund. I purchased a YouCam subscription and realized within minutes that it did not provide the features I believed I was paying for. I attempted to cancel the subscription on the very first day, yet Apple has made it impossible for me to do so.

I submitted refund requests immediately after the purchase, but they were denied without any meaningful explanation. I have tried multiple times to get assistance, but I have not received any helpful support from Apple. Because of this, I even removed Apple from my PayPal account out of concern that I would be charged again without any chance of reimbursement, as has happened before.

It is extremely disappointing that when a product does not work as advertised—or is not what the customer intended to purchase—there is no straightforward way to receive a refund. I used the app for less than two minutes, yet I am still being charged and cannot cancel or remove the subscription.

This experience has been unnecessarily stressful, and I am asking for Apple to review this situation, allow me to cancel the subscription, and issue the refund I requested on the same day of purchase.
